channel.title: Gambia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Gambia, every source cited.

item.title: Barrow blames UDP for stalled constitution
item.description: President Adama Barrow stated opposition lawmakers, particularly the UDP, voted against the draft bill in the National Assembly.

item.title: Gambia drug agency arrests 51 in nationwide sweep
item.description: Suspected cannabis, cocaine, ecstasy, and crystal meth seized in operations across five regions.

item.title: Russia and Africa agree on equal partnership
item.description: The third Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow focuses on practical projects in energy and infrastructure.

item.title: Gambia entrepreneurs join green economy fellowship
item.description: Acumen's six-month program trains leaders in climate and green business with grants up to $50,000.

item.title: Gambia awaits AfDB grant for second green ferry
item.description: Construction of a new ferry is stalled pending a decision on funding from the African Development Bank.
